propositions.description: List of explicit directed propositions supported by exact verbatim quotes

subject.description: Subject entity, must match an extracted concept name

predicate.description: Active directed relationship verb or short predicate phrase (e.g. Discovered, Implements, Regulates, Contradicts)

object.description: Object entity, must match an extracted concept name

evidence_quote.description: Exact verbatim substring from the source text chunk that proves the assertion without a single altered character

qualifiers.description: Optional conditions, temporal scope, or modal qualifiers
